title: Permit Handling Fee Line on Ridgeline Installation Services Contracts
content:
Ridgeline Installation Services charges a permit handling fee on a contract whose permit has been issued and whose permit fee is passed through at cost.

## The fee line

- The permit handling fee posts as one permit handling fee line on the contract at the amount the permit handling fee rule fixes.
- The contract record shows the permit status (not required, required and pending, or issued), recorded by the store from the permit office; the program terms show whether the program passes the permit fee through at cost.
- Once posted, the fee appears on the contract's statement of charges and the contract's balance due rises by the fee.

## Invocation

The fee is posted with the agent-side tool `post_permit_handling_fee_ee01a5f4`. The agent unlocks the tool and then calls it; one call adds one permit handling fee line to the contract, dated the day it is posted.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `install_contract_id` | the reference number of the installation contract the fee is charged on, as returned by the installation contract lookup for the customer | identifier, exactly as returned |
| `fee_amount` | the permit handling fee, in USD | a positive amount written to 2 decimal places (cents); a value with more decimals is rounded half to even to the cent when it is recorded |

## Return

A receipt with `install_charge_id` (the reference number of the new fee line), `install_contract_id` (the contract charged), `contract_number` (the contract number exactly as on the contract), `fee_type` (always `permit_handling_fee`), `amount` (the fee posted, in USD to 2 decimal places), `charge_date` (today's posting date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `balance_due` (the contract's balance due after the fee, in USD to 2 decimal places). A receipt carrying an `install_charge_id` means the fee is on the contract.
